property_summary: When calling transfer with address[] memory _tos containing one element, the reference requires _tos.length > 0 and proceeds, returning true, while the mutant requires _tos.length == 0 and reverts, so the test asserts that a call to transfer with a non-empty _tos array succeeds (does not revert).
change_summary: Change the condition in require statement from _tos.length > 0 to _tos.length == 0
